$comment: Candidate field tables, extracted 2026-10-26 from build 30fe6461. Each key is a function that references at least 8 distinct identifier-like strings via rip-relative lea, and the value is the set of those strings. WHY: a replicated-state class's constructor enumerates its member names exactly this way, which is how ALCReplicatedState's 62 fields were recovered. This is RAW MATERIAL, not an answer: most of these 1154 functions are cvar registries and other reflection tables, and only ONE class (ALCReplicatedState) has been linked to its constructor so far. See meanings.md 'Field names are in the binary' for what this does and does not establish. Regenerate by scanning lea targets in .text and grouping sites by .pdata function; the scan is ~25 minutes.
